subject: Re: Saturday timing
text: Hey, circling back on your note. I know you thought Saturday's slot was too tight, and fair enough. I still think 2 p.m. works, unless you'd rather start later. Just don't want us tripping over times on the day. Could you shoot me a quick yes/no? If you'd prefer 3, I can shuffle the schedule and keep the coffee cart. No hard feelings. Just need a nudge before I print the cards. Thanks again. Talk soon, okay? Cheers.
